pass_a_gloss: Third brother's members lent from heaven; fourth-sixth: no resurrection for tyrant, nation unforsaken, theomachos vs godlike.
pass_b_english: The third held out tongue and hands undaunted: 'These I had from heaven, and for his laws I despise them, and from him I hope to receive them back.' (2 Maccabees 7:10–11) O noble exchange — members lent for a little, to be received incorruptible!

The fourth: 'It is good, being put to death by men, to wait for hope from God, to be raised by him; for as for thee, there shall be no resurrection unto life.' (2 Maccabees 7:14–19) The fifth: 'Thou hast authority among men, being mortal; do what thou wilt. But think not our nation forsaken by God: abide a little and see his great power, how he will torment thee and thy seed.' (2 Maccabees 7:10–19) The sixth: 'Deceive not thyself vainly; we suffer for our own sins against our God — yet think not thou shalt go unpunished, who fightest against those made godlike by the Word.'
